features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migration, no new column and no new table, and the update rewrites no data. The supplier-payment commissions recorded before stay as they are, without a budget item, until you give them one from the «Commissioni senza voce» list (commissions without an item); when you do, the row records who gave it and when, until the payment is edited. What changes is how some figures read: the accounting register starts from the balance carried over from the year before, and the opening balance of the cash accounts is no longer an income; the cash statement no longer counts twice a payment written in the following financial year (see below). The year of the protocol numbers between midnight and one o'clock on 1 January also changes (see below). No new permission, no new library, the requirements do not change. After the update, reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGES: THE NEW YEAR'S PROTOCOL SERIES STARTS AT ITALIAN MIDNIGHT — The protocol number takes the year from the Italian time of whoever administers. Before, it took it from the server clock, which runs on UTC: between 00:00 and 01:00 on 1 January a record of the new year still took the number of the year before (for example FTP-2026-… instead of FTP-2027-00001). This applies to every series (invoices, payments, receipts, immediate settlements, transfers, reversals, F24 payments), to the new ENT series of payments from third parties and to the NC- series of the credit notes created by reversing an invoice. By the same rule the day of the credit note of an invoice reversal, the day of the reversal of a supplier payment and the day of the provision of an amount already paid are now Italian: between 00:00 and 01:00 (02:00 with summer time) they used to take the day before.

CHANGES: «STATO PATRIMONIALE» BECOMES «RENDICONTO», «PRIMA NOTA» BECOMES «REGISTRO DI CONTABILITÀ» — In the movements menu the entry «Stato patrimoniale» (balance sheet) is called «Rendiconto» (financial statement) and opens the new financial-statement page of the year, on the «Sintesi» tab (summary); the old address opens the «Situazione patrimoniale» tab (balance sheet), so the existing links lead where they used to. The entry «Prima nota» is called «Registro di contabilità» (accounting register), the name the law gives it (in the menu row «Registro»; the full name on mouse hover and in the dropdown), and its printout file is called «registro-contabilita-…» instead of «prima-nota-…». The cash statement that the old page called «Riepilogo finanziario dell'esercizio» is called «Entrate e uscite per cassa» (cash receipts and payments) and is on the «Cassa» tab; «Riepilogo finanziario» (financial summary), the name the law uses, is now the accrual-basis statement. The checks that were at the bottom of the page («Controlli di quadratura») have their own tab, «Controlli» (checks), and the one called «Liquidità e riepilogo» is called «Liquidità e cassa». The sentences that gave article 1130-bis words and rules it does not have are removed (in the payment form, in the card of a budget item, in the balances guide, in the empty list of managements and in the description of the contingency accounts that the program creates from now on; those already created stay as they are). The balance-sheet guide says that the assembly decides about the surplus or deficit, no longer that it «andrà a conguaglio» (will go to the final settlement).

CHANGES: THE ACCOUNTING REGISTER STARTS FROM THE BALANCE CARRIED OVER FROM THE YEAR BEFORE — At the top there is the carried-over row: the cash at the start of the financial year, as the registers of the years before leave it (the bank and cash accounts, including the reserve funds, which are a part of them). Before, the running balance started from zero every year, and the printout said so; in the first year the opening balance of the cash accounts was a row among the incomes and inflated the «Totale entrate» (total income). Now the opening is the first year's carried-over balance, and from the second year the carried-over balance is the closing balance of the year before's register, financial year by financial year: a record written in one financial year with the date of another counts in the one it is in, and no payment is counted twice. The register also shows the numbers of the invoices paid by each payment («Pag. FT-C, FT-D — …»), the totals by type of movement (the payments of invoices from previous years apart) and the balance at the end of each month, on screen and in print. The printout says it contains the residents' personal data.

CHANGES: THE COMMISSION OF A SUPPLIER PAYMENT HAS A BUDGET ITEM — In the payment form, new and when editing, with a commission above zero the field «Voce della commissione» (commission item) is mandatory: it offers the expense items of the management of the invoices paid and proposes the item of the last commission of that management in the condominium (never an item deleted or no longer an expense). The commission goes into the actual total of that item, like an immediate settlement. Before, it went to the program's «Spese bancarie» (bank charges) account without an item: it counted in the costs and in the result, but stayed out of the actual totals of the items. Reversing a payment copies the item. To put the commission of an extraordinary-management payment on an item of the ordinary management (the bank charges, for example), the sentence under the field says how: the commission at zero and an immediate settlement, with the link. A payment recorded before without an item can be edited without giving it one, as long as you do not change the commission: at the top of the field there is «Lascia senza voce, come era» (leave without item, as it was); if you change it, even by a cent, the item must be chosen.

CHANGES: IN THE CHART OF ACCOUNTS AN INCOME ITEM SHOWS WHAT WAS COLLECTED — With a payment from third parties recorded, the income item (the antenna rent, the account interest) says «Incassato € …» (collected), with no remainder or excess, and the actual total of the chart does not count the payments as negative expenses. The same holds for the outgoings of the dashboard and for the spending of the chapters of the instalment plan. An income item with expenses recorded before (for example an invoice written when the program allowed it) reads as before, with the actual total.

CHANGES: WHOEVER PAID A PAYMENT FROM THIRD PARTIES CANNOT BE DELETED FROM THE CONTACTS — The accounting register names them as the counterparty: the deletion is refused with the sentence «Questa anagrafica compare come «chi ha versato» in un incasso da terzi: non si può eliminare, perché il registro di contabilità la nomina.» (this contact appears as the payer in a payment from third parties: it cannot be deleted, because the accounting register names it), even if the payment is reversed.

NEW: THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT OF THE YEAR, ON ONE PAGE WITH SIX TABS — «Sintesi» (summary), «Riepilogo finanziario» (financial summary), «Situazione patrimoniale» (balance sheet), «Cassa» (cash), «Condòmini» (residents) and «Controlli» (checks); you reach it from the movements menu, from the list of financial years (the «Rendiconto» entry in the menu of each row) and from the accounting register. The summary has at the top the outcome of the checks, «I controlli: N tornano, M non tornano, K da leggere» (the checks: N add up, M do not add up, K to read), with a row per check leading to the check, and the fixed sentence: the checks verify that the program's figures agree with each other, not the balance against the bank statement, nor that every invoice and every income has been recorded. Below, four boxes (what was resolved with the instalments and the budget; the costs of the year, with the percentage and «di cui per capitolo», of which by chapter; the shares paid out of those issued; the liquidity, according to the accounts), the expenses that are in no chapter (commissions without an item, disputed invoices) and the management statement, with the result: shares issued minus costs. Every figure comes from the tab that shows it; with more than one management the summary adds them up, and the budget is that of the expenses minus the income. The financial-statement pages can also be read with the dark theme.

NEW: THE FINANCIAL SUMMARY, ON AN ACCRUAL BASIS — For each management, the expenses by chapter and item with the budget («Preventivo»), what was resolved with the instalments («Deliberato con le rate»), the actual («Consuntivo»), the year before («Anno prima»), the variance («Scostamento»), what was paid and what is still to pay to suppliers («Pagato», «Da pagare»; at the date: the end of the year for a finished year, today for the open one; the withholding tax counts as paid when it is paid with the F24, until then it is in the amount to pay). From the item the detail by expense opens (each invoice, settlement and commission). Then the income from third parties, with the budget and what was collected; the residents' shares: resolved, issued, paid (paid in or offset), unpaid, the credits on the instalments and the credit carried over; outside the chapters, the commissions without an item, the disputed invoices and the unclassified costs; the result with its two terms, and a row that links the sum of the rows to the costs in the accounts and names the difference. It can be printed, with or without the detail by expense. The budget is the amount of the item as long as the management is not also in a later financial year: from then on the column refers to the minutes of the assembly, because the item usually carries the new budget; what was resolved is what the approved instalment plans ask for, and for plans generated before the program kept the detail of the allocation (1.11.0-beta.29) it is not there: the page says so, and that figure is in the minutes of the assembly that approved the plans.

NEW: THE BALANCE SHEET, WITH THE INVOICES OPEN AT THE DATE — On the page, and no longer in the «Fatture da pagare» window (invoices to pay) that showed today's, the list of the invoices open at the date, for the open year and for a finished one (at its end), with the remainder owed to the supplier net of withholding tax; below, the row «fatture aperte + differenza = debiti verso i fornitori» (open invoices + difference = debts to suppliers), with the names of the difference. The tax office line says «di cui € … di ritenute su fatture non ancora pagate» (of which € … of withholding on invoices not yet paid); the credits towards the residents say «di cui spese anticipate per singole unità, non ancora chieste» (of which expenses advanced for single units, not yet charged); one block per management, with the condominium total. The printout has the outcome of the checks at the top and can be made whole or in parts (the balance sheet, the cash, the checks); it says that it contains only the debts recorded as invoices.

NEW: THE RESIDENTS: POSITIONS AND CREDITS BY AGE — On the «Condòmini» tab, two lists. «Posizioni» (positions): one row per person and unit, with the ordinary and extraordinary shares of the year, the previous years, the credits on the instalments and the total (the advances in a separate column, outside the total), and the rows that link the positions to the credits of the balance sheet. «Crediti per anzianità» (credits by age): one row per unpaid instalment, with the due date, the delay, the year of the due date and that of the plan, for a finished year «Versato dopo» (paid afterwards) and «Resta oggi» (remaining today), and the last letter sent or posted. An instalment that also contains a part of a debt from a year before says so. Each list has its printout; beyond the number of rows the server can print with its memory the printout does not start, and the sentence says so.

NEW: THE CHECKS, WITH THE REAL FIGURES — The «Controlli» tab has ten checks, each with the equation or the count written with the figures and the outcome «torna», «non torna» or «da leggere» (adds up, does not add up, to read): to the six already there are added «Registrazioni oltre il confine dell'esercizio» (records across the boundary of the financial year), «I costi tornano con il riepilogo» (the costs agree with the summary), «I crediti tornano con le posizioni» (the credits agree with the positions) and «Voci e gestione delle fatture» (items and management of the invoices). The first lists, in both directions, the records with the date of the event in one financial year and written in another (the December invoice recorded in January, the December payment written later, the January F24), with the effect on the summary in figures, a table by type and the paged list with the filters (direction, type, colour) and «Apri nel Libro Giornale» (open in the journal); in red those that change what the summary counts (invoices, notes, issues, settlements, payments from third parties, commissions), to read the money that crosses the boundary (instalment payments, supplier payments, F24, transfers, refunds and their reversals). An invoice recorded as previous-year debt is to read on the page of the financial year it is in, which does not count it as a cost, and in red on the page of the year of its date; if it has a part not covered by the opening balances, that part is a cost of the year it is in, and the row stays red. Next to a check that does not add up there is what to do; no button corrects by itself. The check «Liquidità e cassa» removes from the comparison the money that crosses the end of the financial year and names it; when, in a financial year, the records with a date that falls in no financial year of the condominium are more than those with the date in its period, the check gives the figures and the two possible causes (the dates of the financial year are wrong, or they are records of a financial year that does not exist in the program), with «Modifica l'esercizio» (edit the financial year).

NEW: THE FILE FOR THE ASSEMBLY, IN ONE PDF — From the summary, «Scarica il fascicolo» (download the file): choose the parts (the financial summary, with or without the detail by expense, the balance sheet, the cash receipts and payments, the residents, the accounting register, the checks; the choice stays on that computer) and the program joins them always in the same order, each with the orientation of its own printout, with a title page: the practice, the condominium, the financial year, the figures of the statement, the outcome of the checks with the meaning of «non torna» (two figures of the program do not agree, and the row of the check says why; it is not proof of a shortfall) and of «da leggere», the index with the pages (or why a part was skipped) and the space for the signature. When it contains the residents or the register, the title page says it contains their personal data, is for the residents and the assembly, and must not be posted on the notice board or passed on to others. The footer of the pages of each part gives its name («Situazione patrimoniale, pagina 1 di 2»). The financial-statement printouts speak to whoever receives them at the assembly: they say what «non torna» and «da leggere» mean, write the minus sign in one way only and the result with its word (surplus or deficit), and say with words for the residents some sentences that on screen are written for whoever works (the remedies for the year across the boundary, the comparison with the bank statement, the expenses paid without an invoice). The file first estimates the time and memory of all the parts together: beyond the server's limit it does not start, goes back to the summary and says which part to remove, and whether that part can be downloaded by itself from its tab. After the click the button stays disabled for a minute, so the file is not requested twice in a row.

NEW: THE PAYMENT FROM THIRD PARTIES — From the payments page, «Altro incasso» (other payment): the money coming in from someone who is not a resident (the antenna rent, the account interest, a refund), on the income item of the chart of accounts. Choose the date, the amount, the income item, the bank or the cash box (not a reserve fund: to set money aside, record the payment on the bank and then make a transfer), who paid (optional, from the contacts) and the description; the preview shows the two rows of the entry. The movement has the ENT protocol, goes into the accounting register with who paid, raises the bank balance and reduces the costs of the year, as the plan already reduces the shares. It is cancelled with «Storna» (reverse) from the entry page, choosing why: a wrong record (it counts from the day of the payment, or from today if its financial year is closed) or a payment that came back (it counts from today). If the chart of accounts has no income item, the page says to create one with a zero budget. You also reach it from the financial summary and from the sentence of the invoice list about the settlements written on an income item.

NEW: THE COMMISSIONS WITHOUT AN ITEM — For each financial year, the list of the payment commissions recorded without an item, with their reversal next to them, and «Assegna la voce» (assign the item), also in bulk; it can be assigned only in open financial years, and the statements of closed years do not change. You reach it from the financial summary, from the summary tab and from the box of the payments list, which counts those that can be given an item. The journal row records who gave the item, when, and where it was before; a later edit of the payment removes this note.

NEW: A PERSON'S CORRESPONDENCE, IN A TAB — In a person's account statement two tabs: «Movimenti contabili» (accounting movements), open by default, and «Corrispondenza (N)» (correspondence), with what the program has issued for the person in that condominium: the letters (with their actions, as before), the receipts and the compensation notices, and the «non serve comunicarla» choices (no need to communicate it), from the most recent, ten per page, with the filters by type and by period, which are not remembered; notice-board announcements are not included. Each receipt and each notice leads to its payment, if the payment still exists («Apri l'incasso n. …», open payment no. …); a receipt of someone who paid for another says on whose behalf. At the top of the page the row of the last letter. From «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments), for whoever already has a letter, «Vedi la corrispondenza» (see the correspondence) opens the tab.

FIXES: THE PDFS ON A HOSTING THAT FORBIDS CHANGING THE TIME LIMIT — On a hosting that forbids PHP to raise its own time limit (the set_time_limit function among the disabled ones, as happens on many shared hostings) and with a limit below 120 seconds, from 1.11.0-beta.23 every PDF printout stopped with an error. Now the printout starts, with the hosting's time limit.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The checks say whether the program's figures agree with each other: they do not compare the balance with the bank statement and do not know whether an invoice is missing. (2) A record goes into the financial year that is open when you write it, not the one of its date (an F24 payment goes into the year of its tax form, the reversal of a payment into the year of the payment): this is why almost every year some sit across the boundary, and the check lists them without moving them; «non torna» for that check is frequent even with correct data. (3) The budget next to the actual is there as long as the management is not also in a later financial year; what was resolved with the instalments of plans generated before 1.11.0-beta.29 is not there. (4) The file and the financial-statement printouts that grow with the data (the summary, the balance sheet, the positions, the credits by age, the register) have a ceiling, measured on memory and, for the file, also on time: beyond it, the printout does not start and the page says why and what to do. (5) The commission of an extraordinary-management payment goes on an item of its own management; to put it among the bank charges of the ordinary one an immediate settlement is needed. (6) The payment from third parties records the figure that reached the bank: for the account interest, the withholding the bank keeps is not recorded separately. (7) The commissions written before without an item stay out of the actual totals of the items until you give them one; the item can be given only in open financial years. (8) The printout of the year across the boundary lists the first 50 records across it; the «Controlli» tab shows them all, page by page. (9) The debt of a year before that the plan put inside the instalments («nella prima rata» or «in tutte le rate», in the first instalment or in all of them) stays in the shares of the year in the positions, and the row says «contiene anche una parte di pregresso» (it also contains a part of previous-year debt).
